abort.wrong_device: The projector at this address is a different device.

data_description.password: PJLink password. Leave empty if authentication is disabled.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the projector.
data_description.password: PJLink password. Leave empty if authentication is disabled.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The projector rejected the password. Enter the current PJLink password.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll while the projector is idle. Warm-up and cool-down are always polled every 5 seconds.
data_description.lamp_warning_hours: Create a repair issue when the lamp reaches this many hours. 0 disables it.
data_description.filter_warning_hours: Create a repair issue when the filter reaches this many hours. 0 disables it.
data_description.push: Listen on UDP port 4352 for instant updates. Needs Home Assistant on the same network as the projector (host networking in Docker).
data_description.keep_connection: Faster, but holds the projector's PJLink session. Turn off if another control system (Crestron, Extron, vendor software) also talks PJLink to this projector: the connection then closes after every polling cycle.

invalid_auth.message: The projector rejected the PJLink password.

not_supported.message: The projector does not support the {command} command.

lamp_hours.title: {name}: lamp needs replacement
lamp_hours.description: The lamp / light source of {name} has {hours} hours (warning at {limit}). Replacement model: {model}. Change the threshold in the integration options.

filter_hours.title: {name}: clean or replace the filter
filter_hours.description: The filter of {name} has {hours} hours (warning at {limit}). Replacement model: {model}. Reset the filter counter on the projector after servicing it.

projector_error.title: {name} reports an error
projector_error.description: The projector reports an error in: {categories}. Check the projector; this issue disappears once the error clears.

Fix your YAML configuration and restart Home Assistant, or remove the {domain} entry from your configuration and set the integration up from the UI.

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_aut.title: The PJLink YAML configuration import failed
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_aut.description: Configuring {integration_title} via YAML is deprecated. While importing your configuration, invalid authentication details were found. Fix your YAML configuration and restart Home Assistant, or remove the {domain} entry from your configuration and set the integration up from the UI.

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown.title: The PJLink YAML configuration import failed
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown.description: Configuring {integration_title} via YAML is deprecated. While importing your configuration, an unexpected error occurred. Fix your YAML configuration and restart Home Assistant, or remove the {domain} entry from your configuration and set the integration up from the UI.
